summary: @servicetitan/cp-api preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, extracts and chmods it, then uses it to execute math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. The payload is unrelated to the package's advertised axios-helper purpose and uses string-array index-rotation obfuscation (WV8StW / MmgoCP) with garbled single-letter identifiers. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled identifiers (_0xNNNN) and per-function string maps, atypical of legitimate install tooling. The Bun runtime is fetched specifically so the obfuscated payload runs outside Node's lifecycle context, evading Node-based scanners at install time on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
